name: Vertiv CoolChip CDU 2300kW
description: Liquid-to-liquid in-row/perimeter CDU separating facility water from the secondary fluid network (TCS) for direct-to-chip AI pods; redundant pumps (N+N), 6 in sanitary flanges top or bottom, unit-to-unit group modes. Vertiv marks the 2026 datasheet as preliminary.

capacity_w.note: nominal 2300 kW at 4 C approach temperature difference; rating conditions per SL-80005-SP: primary (facility) inlet 32 C (ASHRAE W3), secondary outlet 36 C, PG-25 secondary at 10 K delta-T

max_flow_kg_s.note: max secondary circuit flow 3400 L/min; 3400 * 0.998 kg/L / 60 = 56.55 kg/s (water density; PG-25 is ~2% denser)

approach_k.note: vendor ATD = secondary supply minus facility supply: 36 C TCS outlet with 32 C facility inlet

pump_head_kpa.note: available external head not published; Vertiv says to contact sales for detailed performance data

secondary_delta_t_k.note: secondary delta-T with PG-25 at rating

facility_supply_c.note: primary circuit temperature at rating (ASHRAE W3)

filtration_um.note: secondary filtration 25 or 50 micron; primary field-supplied 500 micron

attrs.pump_redundancy: N+N (reduced capacity on one pump set)

sources.title: Vertiv CoolChip CDU 2300kW datasheet SL-80607 (08/26, preliminary)
